title: SGI Fusion - FSN 3d File System Navigator
summary: A short screen capture of SGI's File System Navigator (FSN, also called Fusion) running on IRIX 6.5 on an Octane. It shows the 3D file browser seen in Jurassic Park.
why: Linked as proof that the 3D file manager in Jurassic Park was a real Unix application, in threads on movie UIs.

quote.text: In that clip, you can see fsn , which is a genuinely real 3D file manager for IRIX
